2607.14886.title: Reachability-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Target-Oriented Path Exploration in Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
2607.14886.paper_summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) reasoning under the extrapolation setting focuses on forecasting future time-stamped events (facts) from historical data in a temporal knowledge graph. Existing approaches, reinforcement learning (RL)-based multi-hop reasoning methods are prominent for TKG reasoning because they produce human-interpretable predictions via explicit multi-hop path tracing. However, during RL training, rewards are typically sparse, and exploration is highly inefficient due to the vast, time-evolving action space. These issues hinder efficient training and often limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose RAPTOR (Reachability-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Target-Oriented Path Exploration), a self-supervised pretraining method that injects a reachability-aware inductive bias to the agent. By learning to estimate the reachability of candidate actions to the target entity, RAPTOR reduces exploration over unpromising paths and provides a strong initialization for downstream RL fine-tuning. Experimental results on the ICEWS14, ICEWS05-15, and ICEWS18 datasets demonstrate that RAPTOR pretraining markedly improves the training efficiency and consistently outperforms conventional baselines, establishing it as an effective approach for enhancing RL-based multi-hop reasoning methods for TKG reasoning.
2607.14886.paper_summary_zh: 時間知識圖譜（TKG）推理在外推設定下專注於從時間知識圖譜中的歷史數據預測未來的時間戳事件（事實）。現有的方法中，基於強化學習（RL）的多跳推理方法在TKG推理中非常突出，因為它們通過明確的多跳路徑追蹤產生可被人類解釋的預測。然而，在RL訓練過程中，獎勵通常是稀疏的，且由於龐大且隨時間演變的行動空間，探索效率極低。這些問題妨礙了高效的訓練，並且通常限制了整體性能。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了RAPTOR（可達性意識的高效目標導向路徑探索預訓練），這是一種自我監督的預訓練方法，為代理注入可達性意識的歸納偏見。通過學習估計候選行動對目標實體的可達性，RAPTOR減少了對不具前景路徑的探索，並為下游的RL微調提供了強大的初始化。ICEWS14、ICEWS05-15和ICEWS18數據集上的實驗結果表明，RAPTOR預訓練顯著提高了訓練效率，並始終超越傳統基準，確立了其作為增強基於RL的多跳推理方法在TKG推理中有效方法的地位。
2607.14886.author: Chien-Liang Liu et.al.
